nodes.Name: transitionFunc
nodes.DocComment:
transitionFunc is the array of context transition functions for text nodes.
A transition function takes a context and template text input, and returns
the updated context and the number of bytes consumed from the front of the
input.
nodes.ValueLiteral: [...]func(context, []byte) (context, int){stateText: tText, stateTag: tTag, stateAttrName: tAttrName, stateAfterName: tAfterName, stateBeforeValue: tBeforeValue, stateHTMLCmt: tHTMLCmt, stateRCDATA: tSpecialTagEnd, stateAttr: tAttr, stateURL: tURL, stateSrcset: tURL, stateJS: tJS, stateJSDqStr: tJSDelimited, stateJSSqStr: tJSDelimited, stateJSRegexp: tJSDelimited, stateJSTmplLit: tJSTmpl, stateJSBlockCmt: tBlockCmt, stateJSLineCmt: tLineCmt, stateJSHTMLOpenCmt: tLineCmt, stateJSHTMLCloseCmt: tLineCmt, stateCSS: tCSS, stateCSSDqStr: tCSSStr, stateCSSSqStr: tCSSStr, stateCSSDqURL: tCSSStr, stateCSSSqURL: tCSSStr, stateCSSURL: tCSSStr, stateCSSBlockCmt: tBlockCmt, stateCSSLineCmt: tLineCmt, stateError: tError}

nodes.Name: tText
nodes.DocComment: tText is the context transition function for the text state.

nodes.Name: elementContentType
nodes.ValueLiteral: [...]state{elementNone: stateText, elementScript: stateJS, elementStyle: stateCSS, elementTextarea: stateRCDATA, elementTitle: stateRCDATA}

nodes.Name: tTag
nodes.DocComment: tTag is the context transition function for the tag state.

nodes.Name: tAttrName
nodes.DocComment: tAttrName is the context transition function for stateAttrName.

nodes.Name: tAfterName
nodes.DocComment: tAfterName is the context transition function for stateAfterName.

nodes.Name: attrStartStates
nodes.ValueLiteral: [...]state{attrNone: stateAttr, attrScript: stateJS, attrScriptType: stateAttr, attrStyle: stateCSS, attrURL: stateURL, attrSrcset: stateSrcset}

nodes.Name: tBeforeValue
nodes.DocComment: tBeforeValue is the context transition function for stateBeforeValue.

nodes.Name: tHTMLCmt
nodes.DocComment: tHTMLCmt is the context transition function for stateHTMLCmt.

nodes.Name: specialTagEndMarkers
nodes.DocComment:
specialTagEndMarkers maps element types to the character sequence that
case-insensitively signals the end of the special tag body.

nodes.Name: tSpecialTagEnd
nodes.DocComment:
tSpecialTagEnd is the context transition function for raw text and RCDATA
element states.

nodes.Name: indexTagEnd
nodes.DocComment: indexTagEnd finds the index of a special tag end in a case insensitive way, or returns -1

nodes.Name: tAttr
nodes.DocComment: tAttr is the context transition function for the attribute state.

nodes.Name: tURL
nodes.DocComment: tURL is the context transition function for the URL state.

nodes.Name: tJS
nodes.DocComment: tJS is the context transition function for the JS state.

nodes.Name: tJSDelimited
nodes.DocComment:
tJSDelimited is the context transition function for the JS string and regexp
states.

nodes.Name: tBlockCmt
nodes.DocComment: tBlockCmt is the context transition function for /*comment*/ states.

nodes.Name: tLineCmt
nodes.DocComment: tLineCmt is the context transition function for //comment states, and the JS HTML-like comment state.

nodes.Name: tCSS
nodes.DocComment: tCSS is the context transition function for the CSS state.

nodes.Name: tCSSStr
nodes.DocComment: tCSSStr is the context transition function for the CSS string and URL states.

nodes.Name: tError
nodes.DocComment: tError is the context transition function for the error state.

nodes.Name: eatAttrName
nodes.DocComment:
eatAttrName returns the largest j such that s[i:j] is an attribute name.
It returns an error if s[i:] does not look like it begins with an
attribute name, such as encountering a quote mark without a preceding
equals sign.

nodes.Name: asciiAlpha
nodes.DocComment: asciiAlpha reports whether c is an ASCII letter.

nodes.Name: asciiAlphaNum
nodes.DocComment: asciiAlphaNum reports whether c is an ASCII letter or digit.

nodes.Name: eatTagName
nodes.DocComment: eatTagName returns the largest j such that s[i:j] is a tag name and the tag type.

nodes.Name: eatWhiteSpace
nodes.DocComment: eatWhiteSpace returns the largest j such that s[i:j] is white space.
